name: Fazamorexant
summary: Fazamorexant (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), sold under the brand name Mengping, is an orexin receptor antagonist which is used in the treatment of insomnia in China. It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: Fazamorexant (INN), sold under the brand name Mengping, is an orexin receptor antagonist which is used in the treatment of insomnia in China. The drug acts as a dual orexin receptor antagonist (DORA), or as an antagonist of both the orexin OX1 and OX2 receptors.

uses.text: Fazamorexant (INN), sold under the brand name Mengping, is an orexin receptor antagonist which is used in the treatment of insomnia in China. Fazamorexant was developed by Jiangsu Yangtze River Pharmaceutical Group and/or Shanghai Haiyan Pharmaceutical Technology in China. The drug was approved in China in May 2026.
